Flow.description:
Quick Action screen flow on Opportunity (BRD ALF-RS-06 / LFRDN-336). Blocks with a message if the Opportunity already has a Quote (only one quotation per Opportunity - use the existing one to review/reissue). Otherwise lets a Sales Rep pick Quote Type (Customer/Bank Quotation), creates the Quote header, bulk-copies eligible Opportunity Line Items (Vehicle/Accessory/Package/Tint/Customization) across as Quote Line Items in one bulkified create, and auto-adds a negative Trade-In Deduction line if an Approved+Accepted Appraisal exists on the Opportunity. AF_FL_QuoteLineItem_SyncVINDisplay and AF_FL_Vehicle_SyncVINOnRestock handle VIN suppression/population/reissue automatically once lines exist - no separate VIN-required flag needed on this screen (BRD AC1/AC2/FR2 are satisfied by that automatic behavior alone). Real gap found and fixed 2026-09-08 during ALF-RS-04 full-persona-cycle testing: Get_Approved_Appraisal previously only checked AF_ApprovalStatus__c=Approved, but AF_VR_QLI_TradeInDeductionGate (LFRDN-630, pre-existing in the org) requires the linked Trade-In to ALSO have AF_TradeInOutcome__c=Accepted before a Trade-In Deduction line can be created - Approved alone throws FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION and blocks the whole Create_TradeIn_Deduction_Line step (and, since it's not the terminal step, the flow's success screen never displays even though the Quote and other lines were already committed). AF_TradeInOutcome__c is a separate, later "rep-recorded outcome" step performed by the initiating rep after Used Car Team approval (see AF_FL_Appraisal_ApprovalApproved's own notification text: "Record the customer outcome and continue with the quotation"). Added AF_TradeInOutcome__c=Accepted to the same filter - mirrors the identical fix already applied to AF_FL_Appraisal_RetroAddTradeInToQuote (the reverse-sequencing flow for when the Quote already exists before approval). FOURTH real gap found live in QA: Product2Id/PricebookEntryId for the Trade-In Deduction line were hardcoded to DEV-specific record Ids, which do not exist in QA (or any other org) - Ids are never portable across orgs. Fixed by looking up Product2 by ProductCode='AF-TRADEIN-DEDUCT' and its active PricebookEntry on the Quote's own Pricebook2Id (same as Get_Opportunity.Pricebook2Id used to create the Quote) via Get_TradeIn_Product / Get_TradeIn_PricebookEntry, instead of hardcoded literals - org-portable, and also correctly respects an Opportunity on a non-Standard Pricebook, which the old hardcoded PricebookEntryId could never do. Identical fix already applied to AF_FL_Appraisal_RetroAddTradeInToQuote.
2026-09-10 fixes: (LFRDN-637) the flow never wrote AF_VINDisplay__c at creation time - AF_FL_QuoteLineItem_SyncVINDisplay, which the description above assumed handled this, does not exist in the org. Added Get_Selected_Vehicle (looks up Get_Opportunity.AF_SelectedVehicle__c) and Formula_InitialVINDisplay (VIN when the vehicle is In Stock, blank otherwise), assigned into Create_Quote.AF_VINDisplay__c. (LFRDN-638) Get_Eligible_OpportunityLineItems had no line-type filter at all, so Internal Requisition/Provider Service cost lines were copied onto customer-facing quotations; and Add_Line_To_Collection hardcoded AF_CustomerFacing__c/AF_IncludedInQuote__c to true, silently overwriting a source line explicitly flagged false. Fixed by restricting the lookup to LineItemType IN (Vehicle, Accessory, Package, Tint, Customization) AND AF_IncludedInQuote__c != false, and by copying AF_CustomerFacing__c/AF_IncludedInQuote__c from the source OpportunityLineItem instead of hardcoding true. (LFRDN-641) Get_TradeIn_PricebookEntry finding zero rows (e.g. an Opportunity on a non-Standard Pricebook, since AF-TRADEIN-DEDUCT is only priced on Standard by design - only Standard should be in use) previously fell through into Create_TradeIn_Deduction_Line, which then faulted on the required PricebookEntryId field with a generic, confusing error. First fix attempt (same day) added a Has_TradeIn_PricebookEntry check but placed it AFTER Create_Quote already ran - screen flow steps commit immediately and are not transactional across screens, so the error screen displayed correctly but left an orphaned, empty Quote behind (worse than the original behavior, which at least rolled back the whole DML). REAL FIX: added a duplicate pre-check chain (Get_Approved_Appraisal_PreCheck / Get_TradeIn_Product_PreCheck / Get_TradeIn_PricebookEntry_PreCheck / Has_Approved_TradeIn_PreCheck / Has_TradeIn_PricebookEntry_PreCheck) that runs BEFORE Create_Quote, off Get_Selected_Vehicle - if there's no approved trade-in it skips straight to Create_Quote as before; if there is one, it verifies pricing exists on this Pricebook and only then proceeds to Create_Quote, otherwise routes to Screen_TradeInNotPriced with nothing committed yet. The original post-Create_Quote chain (Get_Approved_Appraisal / Has_Approved_TradeIn / Get_TradeIn_Product / Get_TradeIn_PricebookEntry / Has_TradeIn_PricebookEntry / Create_TradeIn_Deduction_Line) is left in place unchanged and still does the actual deduction-line creation - the pre-check only decides whether it's safe to proceed, it duplicates two lookups but avoids any risk of behavior drift from restructuring the already-verified working path.
Second 2026-09-10 fix, after live user testing: Get_Eligible_OpportunityLineItems' hard LineItemType filter (Vehicle/Accessory/Package/Tint/Customization) meant a line explicitly re-flagged AF_IncludedInQuote__c=true by staff (e.g. an Internal Requisition line someone deliberately decided should be customer-visible this one time) could never reach the quote no matter what the flag said - the type filter silently overrode staff's explicit choice. Removed the LineItemType filter entirely; the lookup now trusts AF_IncludedInQuote__c=true alone (changed from a NotEqualTo-false check to an explicit EqualTo-true check, so a blank/never-set flag is correctly treated as excluded, not accidentally included). Internal-cost protection is now enforced entirely at the source: AF_FL_AddProductsToOpportunity defaults Internal Requisition lines to AF_IncludedInQuote__c=false and everything else to true, and the vehicle-selection path in AF_VehicleExplorerController defaults every vehicle/line-variant line to true - so exclusion is opt-in by product type at creation time, not a hardcoded type-based wall in the quoting flow itself. Also added a Get_Eligible_OpportunityLineItems_PreCheck / Has_Eligible_Lines_PreCheck gate (same pre-Create_Quote pattern as the trade-in pricing pre-check) so an Opportunity with zero AF_IncludedInQuote__c=true lines now shows Screen_NoEligibleLines and creates nothing, instead of silently producing an empty Quote.
2026-09-12 fix: this flow previously blocked a SECOND quote of ANY type once one Quote existed (Get_Existing_Quote / Quote_Already_Exists checked OpportunityId alone) - stricter than the actual business rule, which allows exactly one Customer Quotation AND one Bank Quotation per Opportunity (2 total), not just one Quote overall. Replaced the single Get_Existing_Quote lookup with type-scoped Get_Existing_CustomerQuote / Get_Existing_BankQuote; Quote_Already_Exists now only blocks upfront when BOTH types already exist. Added Chosen_Type_Already_Exists right after Screen_QuoteType so if only one type is taken, picking that specific type on the radio buttons is still caught before Create_Quote runs (radio choices aren't filtered dynamically - this catch covers it either way, including the case where a second tab created the other type between screens). This UI-layer check is paired with a save-time backstop, AF_FL_Quote_EnforceOneQuotePerTypePerOpportunity (RecordBeforeSave on Quote), which enforces the same 1-Customer/1-Bank cap for any Quote creation path outside this screen flow (data load, API, standard New button).
2026-09-12 fix (LFRDN-637 follow-up): screen flow steps commit immediately per-screen and are NOT transactional (same root cause already documented above for the 2026-09-10 trade-in-pricing fix) - Create_Quote commits before Create_QuoteLineItems/Create_TradeIn_Deduction_Line run, so when either of those later steps faults (the immediate trigger was QuoteLineItem.AF_LineItemType__c missing the "Trim/Line Variant" value - now fixed on the field itself), the user saw Screen_Error but an empty, lineless Quote was left behind, already visible on the Opportunity. Rather than relying solely on catching every possible future picklist/validation mismatch ahead of time, added Rollback_Quote_After_Line_Failure (deletes the Quote by Var_NewQuoteId) as both faultConnectors' target instead of going straight to Screen_Error - so ANY failure after Create_Quote and before Screen_Confirmation now cleans up the orphaned header instead of leaving it behind, regardless of what specifically caused the failure.
2026-09-13 fix: the rollback delete above itself silently failed for every real persona - Rollback_Quote_After_Line_Failure ran in the interactive user's own context, and no AF persona permission set (Sales Rep/Sales Manager/Showroom Manager) grants allowDelete on Quote by design, so the delete threw INSUFFICIENT_ACCESS_OR_READONLY and the orphaned Quote from the fix above was left behind anyway, now with an extra confusing error on top. Root cause reproduced live: LFRDN-642's test Opportunity was missing its Vehicle OpportunityLineItem (an artifact of how the test record was rebuilt via Apex, not a real bug), which starved Create_QuoteLineItems of any eligible line and triggered the exact fault this rollback exists to clean up - and the cleanup itself then failed. Fixed by setting runInMode=SystemModeWithoutSharing on the whole flow, so the rollback delete (and every other step) runs with full object access regardless of the interactive user's own permissions - this does not grant Sales Rep/Manager any new ability outside the flow; AF_PS_Quote_FullAccess's allowDelete stays false, deliberately, for direct user action on Quote.

Quotation created.

Review the line items on the new Quote record and present it to the customer.

fields.name: Text_NoEligibleLines
fields.fieldText:
This Opportunity has no products to quote.

None of this Opportunity's products are marked "Included in Quote." Check the Opportunity Products related list and mark at least one product as included before generating a quotation.

fields.name: Text_NoVehicle
fields.fieldText:
No vehicle or model is selected on this Opportunity.

Select a Vehicle or Model before generating a quotation.

fields.name: Text_QuoteAlreadyExists
fields.fieldText:
This Opportunity already has that quotation type.

Only one Customer Quotation and one Bank Quotation are allowed per Opportunity (maximum 2 total). Open the existing Quote from the Quotes related list to review or update it - for example, once a vehicle's VIN becomes available, the VIN will be added to that same quote automatically.

fields.name: Text_TradeInNotPriced
fields.fieldText:
The trade-in deduction could not be added.

The trade-in deduction product is not priced on this Opportunity's price book. Contact your administrator - this Opportunity may be on a price book that should not be in use.
